not_claimed: No external users are claimed while confirmed_external_users is zero.
No customer feedback is claimed while external_feedback_items is zero.
No real business impact is claimed while business_case_feedback_items is zero.
No GitHub star growth is claimed while github_stars is zero.
No accepted real-model LLM run is claimed while accepted_real_model_runs is zero.
GitHub traffic is treated as repository interest, not as users.
purpose: Give reviewers one short public hub for submitting evidence that can turn zero-count resume outcomes into evidence-backed claims after the external evidence gate accepts them.
resume_safe_summary: Published a CI-verified reviewer submission hub with 6 public submission paths, 6 tracked outcome metrics, 24 required evidence fields, and zero current outcome claims upgraded.

submission_paths.counting_rule: Counts only after a non-owner public issue grants permission and passes the evidence gate.
Counts only when the reviewer ran or opened a runnable path and submitted observed-result evidence.
required_evidence: permission to count public run evidence

submission_paths.counting_rule: Counts only when a non-owner submits a sanitized business-data replay issue with run evidence, agent trace summary, and permission to count publicly.
required_evidence: selected tools shown in the agent trace
what the agent caught or missed

submission_paths.counting_rule: Counts only when the business case is anonymized, permissioned, and contains no raw production data.
Counts only when an external reviewer inspects implementation evidence and grants permission.
required_evidence: permission to count public AI Engineer feedback

submission_paths.counting_rule: Counts only from GitHub public star data; never asks for fake engagement.
required_evidence: public GitHub star count above zero
no paid, traded, or fake engagement

accepted_real_model_runs.blocked_reason: Needs one accepted redacted real-model run issue with tool calls, tokens, latency, cost, and verification evidence.

ai_engineer_review_items.blocked_reason: Needs a non-owner AI Engineer review issue with inspected paths and permission to count.

business_case_feedback_items.blocked_reason: Needs anonymized business-case issue evidence with explicit permission to count.

confirmed_external_users.blocked_reason: Needs a non-owner public reviewer issue that passes the external evidence gate.

external_feedback_items.blocked_reason: Needs accepted public feedback with permission to count and non-placeholder comments.

github_stars.blocked_reason: Needs public GitHub stars above zero; never buy, trade, or fake stars.

reproducible_feedback_items.blocked_reason: Needs reviewer-submitted command, URL, and observed-result evidence.
